newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end buoyant,off new intra-day high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end buoyant,off new intra-day high.

text.p: Austrian shares powered ahead on Tuesday to a record intra-day high of 1,258.34, but eased after profit taking to close firm and traders said they expected to see mild consolidation on Wednesday.
"Some of the big stocks weren't able to hold onto their highs," one trader said, noting the index was well-supported at 1,240 points.
"Basically the market looks very friendly," one trader said. Even if the market appeared a bit overbought, there was little chance of a major setback due to the strong fundamentals, he added.

Another dealer was also upbeat. "The bears are having a hard time of it at the moment," he said. The uptrend should continue, he noted, but warned that the tone was not equally positive across the board.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips climbed 10.47 points or 0.84 percent to 1,256.43. Among its constituents 17 shares rose and four fell.
The session's top gainer Mayr-Melnhof rose 3.17 percent to 650 schillings.
Bank Austria preferred shares led the decliners, shedding 0.73 percent to 411.95.
The March ATX future added 10.9 points to 1,257.5.
